dialog.english: We have no clue how to use it.

But we still haven't found all the
Crests yet.
dialog.translation:
Aún no hemos encontrado todos
los Emblemas.

dialog.english:
Let's wait until all of us have a
Crest so that we can try and
figure this out.
dialog.translation:
Esperemos a que todos tengamos
un Emblema para intentar
averiguar esto.

dialog.english:
Agumon! Evolve! You need to
evolve!

But what if that doesn't work?
What if he turns into something
other than Greymon...?
dialog.translation:
¿Pero y si no funciona?
¿Y si se convierte en algo
distinto a Greymon...?

dialog.english: Come on, what are you doing?

Pi, pi, pi. Did you see the power
of my magic?
dialog.translation:
Pi, pi, pi. ¿Habéis visto el poder
de mi magia?

dialog.english:
You're the Chosen Children, aren't
you? That was a really close call,
it was painful to watch, pi!
dialog.translation:
Sois los Niños Elegidos, ¿no?
¡Menudo susto habéis pasado,
daba pena miraros, pi!

dialog.english:
Those Crests and Tags are just
wasted on you, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Los Emblemas y Circuitos
son un desperdicio con
vosotros, pi!

dialog.english: This Digimon isn't cute at all.
dialog.translation: Este Digimon no es nada mono.

dialog.english:
You Digimon are slacking off as
well, pi! You lack exertion and
guts, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Vosotros Digimon también
estáis vagos, pi! ¡Falta
esfuerzo y agallas, pi!

dialog.english:
That's why, starting today, all of
you will be training under me, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Por eso, a partir de hoy,
todos entrenaréis conmigo, pi!

dialog.english:
Especially the two of you over
there!

You two are severely afflicted,
pi! You'll be getting the super
special training course, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Vosotros dos estáis fatal,
pi! ¡Tendréis el supercurso
especial de entrenamiento, pi!

dialog.english: What kind of Digimon is he?

He's fussy, but he's not a bad
Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Es quisquilloso pero no
es mal Digimon.

dialog.english:
Doesn't seem to have a black gear,
either.
dialog.translation:
Tampoco parece tener una rueda
negra.

dialog.english:
What are you doing? Hurry up and
get over here, pi!
dialog.translation:
¿Qué hacéis? ¡Daos prisa y
venid aquí, pi!

dialog.english:
We have to climb all the way up
*there*?
You know, Etemon is chasing us.

We shouldn't be hanging around in
one place for too long.
dialog.translation:
No deberíamos quedarnos
en un sitio tanto tiempo.

dialog.english:
No need to worry, pi! My barrier
can't be seen from the outside,
pi!
dialog.translation:
¡No os preocupéis, pi! ¡Mi
barrera no se ve desde
fuera, pi!

dialog.english: Are you sure we'll be okay?

We'll just have to believe him for
now.
dialog.translation:
Por ahora solo nos queda
confiar en él.

dialog.english:
Are we really gonna have to climb
that? No way...
dialog.translation:
¿En serio hay que subir
eso? Ni de coña...

dialog.english:
You should be ashamed of being
exhausted so easily, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Deberías avergonzarte de
cansarte tan rápido, pi!

dialog.english:
The first part of your training is
to scrub this floor!
dialog.translation:
¡La primera parte de vuestro
entrenamiento es fregar esto!

dialog.english:
You two severely afflicted ones
get the special menu! Tell me when
you're ready!
dialog.translation:
¡Vosotros dos, los más graves,
tenéis menú especial! ¡Decidme
cuando estéis listos!

dialog.english:
What are we supposed to be doing
in this cave? We can't see a
thing.
dialog.translation:
¿Qué se supone que hacemos
en esta cueva? No vemos
nada.

dialog.english:
At the back of this cave, there's
something important you need to
recover. That's the training, pi!
dialog.translation:
Al fondo de esta cueva hay
algo importante que debéis
recuperar. ¡Es el entreno, pi!

dialog.english:
That's it? Explain a little
better!

Go look for it. That's your
training!
dialog.translation:
Ve a buscarlo. ¡Ese es tu
entreno!

dialog.english:
Piccolomon's not giving us any
training, just a bunch of
confusing riddles!
dialog.translation:
¡Piccolomon no nos da entreno,
solo un montón de acertijos
confusos!

dialog.english:
Is this one of those things we're
supposed to be figuring out once
we get there?
dialog.translation:
¿Es una de esas cosas que hay
que averiguar cuando lleguemos?

dialog.english:
Well, we don't have any other
choice but to try, so let's go.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, no tenemos más remedio
que intentarlo, así que vamos.

dialog.english:
A treasure chest! This must be
what Piccolomon was talking about!
dialog.translation:
¡Un cofre del tesoro! ¡Debe ser
de lo que hablaba Piccolomon!

dialog.english:
He said it was something
important, but it doesn't look
like much from here.
dialog.translation:
Dijo que era algo importante,
pero desde aquí no parece
gran cosa.

dialog.english:
What's happening?! My feet are
sinking into the ground!
dialog.translation:
¡¿Qué pasa?! ¡Mis pies se están
hundiendo en el suelo!

dialog.english:
No, Tai and Agumon haven't
returned.
dialog.translation:
No, Tai y Agumon no han
vuelto.

dialog.english:
You're not gonna leave without us,
are you?

Got woken up by your Tag all
shinin'.

You're gonna go find the Crests,
right? Take us with you!
dialog.translation:
Vais a buscar los Emblemas,
¿no? ¡Llevadnos con vosotros!

dialog.english:
We'll go look for them. It should
be easier if the four of us
combine our efforts.
dialog.translation:
Iremos a buscarlos. Será
más fácil si los cuatro
unimos fuerzas.

dialog.english:
When you consider where the Tag
started shining from, it should be
somewhere in this direction.
dialog.translation:
Si pensamos por dónde empezó
a brillar el Circuito, debería
estar por esta dirección.

dialog.english: My Tag started shining there too.

So, why don't we go on a little
jungle expedition?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué no hacemos
una expedición a la jungla?

dialog.english:
Still, I wonder why both our Tags
reacted at the same time?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué reaccionaron los dos
Circuitos a la vez?

dialog.english: Just focus on finding the Crests.

The Crests fell together when they
were scattered around the
continent.
dialog.translation:
Los Emblemas cayeron juntos
cuando se dispersaron por
el continente.

dialog.english:
I see. It makes sense when you put
it that way.
dialog.translation:
Ya veo. Tiene sentido visto
así.

dialog.english:
Y-you're right...I'm sorry for
asking such a strange thing.
dialog.translation:
T-tienes razón... Perdón por
preguntar algo tan raro.

dialog.english:
The portal of light Piccolomon
made when we came here.
dialog.translation:
El portal de luz que hizo
Piccolomon para venir aquí.

dialog.english:
Seems like we've arrived at the
other side of the barrier.
dialog.translation:
Parece que llegamos al otro
lado de la barrera.

dialog.english:
But the Tags are reactin' to
something right ahead of us.
dialog.translation:
Pero los Circuitos reaccionan
a algo justo delante.

dialog.english:
We've come this far, so let's keep
going!

Matt! That well over there! The
Tag is reacting!
The walls of the well are shining.

Let's try climbing down and
holding out our Tags.
dialog.translation:
Probemos a bajar y sacar
nuestros Circuitos.

dialog.english: Are we gonna be okay, Matt?

Lord Etemon! We've confirmed a
reaction at Area K1!
dialog.translation:
¡Señor Etemon! ¡Confirmamos una
reacción en Área K1!

dialog.english:
Good job! Area K1
is...Tyrannomon's territory!

All right, I'll show the Chosen
Children a pretty little sight for
the eyes!
dialog.translation:
¡Bien, les daré a los Niños
Elegidos un bonito espectáculo
para la vista!

dialog.english:
You ain't no slouch either,
Izzy!
Yes! Now we have five Crests.

You mean Matt, Izzy, 
Gabumon and Tentomon? Apparently
they left to go find their Crests.
dialog.translation:
¿Te refieres a Matt, Izzy,
Gabumon y Tentomon? Parece que
se fueron a buscar sus Emblemas.

dialog.english:
Awww...after all that training,
I'd rather go hunt down some
Crests too...
dialog.translation:
Uy... después de tanto entreno,
prefiero ir a buscar
Emblemas también...

dialog.english:
Don't get distracted by the
others!

I wonder if Matt and Izzy
are okay...
dialog.translation:
Espero que Matt e Izzy
estén bien...

dialog.english:
Matt and Izzy are in
danger!

You can't just *say* that without
warning!
Hurry, we've got to rescue them!

I don't know. We were in that
cave...
dialog.translation:
No lo sé. Estábamos en esa
cueva...

dialog.english:
Dunno. Maybe trying to ride a
bicycle?
dialog.translation:
Ni idea. ¿Quizá intenta montar
en bici?

dialog.english: It's a sort of vehicle. Ah!
I can't...I can't ride a bike...

You can't just give up after only
a few tries! Believe in yourself! 
You'll get it right this time!
dialog.translation:
¡No puedes rendirte tras solo
unos intentos! ¡Cree en ti!
¡Esta vez lo conseguirás!

dialog.english:
That's what I forgot, Agumon. That
I shouldn't get discouraged.
dialog.translation:
Eso es lo que olvidé, Agumon.
Que no debía desanimarme.

dialog.english:
Me, too. That's why I couldn't
become Greymon.
dialog.translation:
Yo también. Por eso no
pude ser Greymon.

dialog.english:
I was afraid you'd turn into
another awful Digimon, so I
chickened out.
dialog.translation:
Temía que te convirtieras
en otro Digimon horrible,
y me acobardé.

dialog.english:
If we combine our powers, I think
I'll be able to evolve again!
dialog.translation:
¡Si combinamos nuestro poder,
podré digievolucionar otra vez!

dialog.english: Everyone! You came to save us!

Now that you're all together in
one place, I'll take you out!
dialog.translation:
¡Ahora que estáis todos juntos
en un sitio, os eliminaré!

dialog.english:
We can't wait for Tai and
Agumon, pi! I don't like it, but
I have to stop Tyrannomon myself.
dialog.translation:
¡No podemos esperar a Tai
y Agumon, pi! No me gusta,
pero debo parar a Tyrannomon.

dialog.english:
Good job on returning, Chosen
Child!

Take 'em all out at once! Go,
Tyrannomon!

But we didn't find anything in
that cave.
dialog.translation:
Pero no encontramos nada
en esa cueva.

dialog.english:
You found what was important,
didn't you?

Even if you don't really
understand it, it'll be fine!
dialog.translation:
¡Aunque no lo entendáis
del todo, estará bien!

dialog.english: I found my Crest, as well.

Yes, but remember, your training
hasn't ended yet, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí, pero recordad que vuestro
entreno no ha acabado, pi!

dialog.english:
Give your all in your training,
pi! Work hard and keep winning,
pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Dadlo todo en el entreno,
pi! ¡Esforzaos y seguid
ganando, pi!

dialog.english:
We should be fine by ourselves.
Worst-case scenario, we have the
barrier.
dialog.translation:
Estaremos bien nosotros
solos. En el peor de los
casos, está la barrera.

dialog.english:
We'll leave this place to you
while we're gone.
dialog.translation:
Te dejamos este sitio
mientras no estamos.

dialog.english:
But will you be okay? This
"special menu"...

If Agumon can't evolve, it'll be a
problem for all of us, so we have
to see this through!
dialog.translation:
¡Si Agumon no digievoluciona,
será un problema para todos,
así que hay que seguir!

dialog.english:
This is a mysterious place. I
wonder how that barrier works?
dialog.translation:
Este sitio es un misterio.
¿Cómo funcionará esa barrera?

dialog.english:
Don't get caught while you examine
the barrier.
dialog.translation:
No te pillen mientras
examinas la barrera.

dialog.english:
Okay, I'll leave the others to
you!
dialog.translation:
¡Vale, te dejo a los demás
a ti!
